title: Architecting the Autonomous Job Agent
content: Today I spent hours figuring out how to make a job search agent truly autonomous. The challenge was handling different DOM structures across multiple job boards. I ended up using a modular scraper pattern in Playwright. It felt great to see the logs start rolling in with matching roles.

title: The 80% Reduction Challenge
content: Refactored a massive legacy infrastructure. Switched from manual EC2 management to full Infrastructure as Code with AWS. The application size dropped by 80% and latency went down by 60%. It was a lesson in the power of modern cloud abstractions.

title: Infortts Foundation & MSME Registration
content: Infortts is officially registered under MSME. Director: Sahil Rathee. Artits is initialized as Sahil's second brain on his local systems and VPS. The network is configured to maintain 24/7 connectivity to Sahil's paired Samsung S24 Ultra and rooted Redmi Note 10 Pro via infortts.site.
